cohort: 1521 mother-child pairs enrolled in the Maternal and Child Health and Nutrition in Acre birth cohort (MINA-Brazil study)
finding: Maternal age ≥ 35 years, primigravida status, pre-pregnancy obesity, higher gestational weight gain, chronic hypertension, and diabetes in pregnancy were associated with a higher prevalence of HDP, which in turn was associated with increased risk for caesarean delivery and prematurity.
mod_finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were associated with an increased risk for cesarean delivery.
